doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Swap is a lobbed projectile, not a movement (data: 'lob a projectile that swaps you'); while it flies (~1.8 s, footage 0158-0167) Void stays roughly in place and nothing in the data or footage locks him, so Gravity Orbs keep firing.

lmb.source: Gravity Orb is an instant shot with no wind-up to wait on (footage 0031-0034); Swap goes at once.

rmb.source: Void Snap slows Void while casting (patch notes), so he keeps acting through its short wind-up; nothing in the data or footage blocks Swap then: the lob goes and the Snap still releases.

e.source: Unstable Anomaly is a quick plant (footage 0352) with no recovery; Swap goes at once.

x.source: Void is held in the cast for Black Hole's 1.0 s telegraph (footage f23-f33) and acts freely once it opens (f50, shooting); the owner (18:20) keeps that ~1 s lock. Shift during the dome is held (never lost) and goes the step the well opens and frees him; after that Swap goes at once.
x.reason: owner 18:20 (replacing item 16): Nightwell locks him in the cast for the 1.0 s dome only; once it opens Shift goes at once

q.source: Gloves are instant items; Swap goes at once.

x.reason: owner 18:20 (replacing item 16): Nightwell locks him in the cast for the 1.0 s dome only; once it opens he jumps at once
x.source: Footage (ult f23-f33): Void is held in the cast for Black Hole's 1.0 s telegraph, then acts freely (f50). Ours: no jump during the dome (Hunter.do_jump refuses while ArchKit.cast_locked()); a jump after it opens goes at once.
